title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Ref: CH017 Vacancy: Customer Service Advisor Location: Crawley, West Sussex Industry: Lighting & Electrical products Salary: up to circa £36,000 per annum, negotiable depending on experience Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 5.30pm, 1 in 3 Saturday mornings 9am to 12.30pm Do you have experience in the electrical wholesale industry? Tired of sales? Want a customer service role instead? This may be just the role for you We are recruiting for a customer service advisor for our client in the Crawley area of West Sussex. As a Customer Advisor you will: - Exceed customers expectations and keep customer service standards maintained - Handle inbound telephone calls and e-mails from customers - Support all aspects of the customer journey from product queries, advice and aftersales care - Take ownership of any general issues, finding suitable solutions for customers - Providing prompt, efficient and consistent information and communication in line with company policy - Liaise with other departments to ensure best service is maintained - Build a strong relationship with the team and customers. The ideal candidate will have - Great spoken and written communication skills - The ability to build a rapport with people quickly and effectively - A professional and pro-active attitude with exceptional attention to detail. - Excellent organisational skills and a passion for providing outstanding customer service - The ability to problem solve quickly and take ownership comfortably - Confident, resilient and assertive decision-making skills - Great MS Office skills - Customer Service experience - Experience in an electrical wholesale business is essential This is a great opportunity to join a growing business with plans for future expansion. If you feel that you have the right skills for this opportunity, please send us your CV. All applications are dealt with in the strictest of confidence. Rhodium Consulting Ltd is a niche recruitment consultancy specialising in wholesalers, merchants and distributors within the building products sector. We strive to be the industry leader in delivering the highest calibre of candidates to our client companies, whilst enhancing the careers of our candidates. For further information and contact details, please visit our website.

title: Customer Service Assistant
description: Morgan McKinley is working with a great growing company based on the outskirts of Horsham in the Partridge Green, West Sussex area who is looking for an experienced Customer Service Executive to provide excellent customer service at all times and be the first point of contact for all incoming enquiries. Salary: 28-32 K Location: Office based - Partridge Green. Own transport required due to location Hours: 8.30am-5.30pm Mon-Fri Customer Service Exec duties: - Act as the first point of contact for all incoming customer enquiries - Process customer information and qualify the call / order, what the customer is looking for etc. - Keep customers updated on what will happen next with their enquiry / order - Update the systems with the enquiry / order information - Maintain strong customer service and answer calls in a timely manner Skills and experience: - Proven experience working in a similar customer service - sales support type role ideally within the manufacturing, construction, or engineering sector - Highly organised and attention to detail - Good IT skills

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Support Role Technical Troubleshooting We re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers, solving problems and learning technical products inside-out. This is not a scripted call-centre role. You will be part of a small, friendly team, supporting customers with our fire safety products and systems. You ll help installers, engineers and end users diagnose issues, resolve faults over the phone and deliver an outstanding customer experience every time. You will be commercially aware and able to spot opportunities to sell through the natural flow of conversations with customers. You will have a number of years experience in a customer service environment and be a great team player. You must be comfortable speaking to customers on the phone and responding to emails. Learning and understanding our products is key to success in this role, so you should be technically curious and willing to develop your product knowledge to ensure you provide the best possible support. A willingness to learn and take a flexible approach is essential. Experience in a customer support role involving hardware and systems will be a great advantage, as will sales support experience. The full job description will be sent to you when you apply.
